Name: Downgrade Transmutation - Transmute Copper Bars
Author: HeyKatu
Description:
A small mod I made for my own game, which allows you to transmute Iron into Copper, Gold into Iron, and Iridium into Gold (I don't know why you'd use this last one, but for completeness' sake, here it is).

This is made for version 1.6 of SDV and requires Content Patcher.


[b]Other Mods:[/b]
Also see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25440]Transmute Iridium[/url] (not my mod).

This is not related to the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18750]Reverse Transmute[/url], which I discovered after I made mine. However, the two are functionally identical except mine also lets you transmute Iridium to Gold.
